promptChangelog: Targets name-mismatch: the claimantName schema description said "policyholder or claimant", which are opposite parties on a liability claim. Now defines it as the policyholder explicitly. Single-string change; instructions and all other field descriptions identical to v1.

failures.note: The nastiest name distractor in the set: the HR contact Vesna Petrović shares a surname with the injured employee, and the employer is Petrović Bau AG. Also tests claimType - a UVG workplace accident is health, not liability.

Two hard calls. 03/04/2025 is ambiguous (3 April vs 4 March) so the date is null. And hail has no category of its own, so the correct answer is "other" - the tempting wrong answer is property-water, which the document rules out by saying the roof is watertight and there was no ingress.
